title: XGBoost classifies benign versus malignant pulmonary nodules in opportunistic CT screening
summary: Among 135 503 physical examinees, 20.40% had clinically tentative benign nodules and 0.45% highly suspicious nodules at baseline. An XGBoost model built on 322 surgically confirmed benign and 196 malignant cases and 15 routine clinical variables reached AUC 0.76 and accuracy 0.75, and AUC 0.87 and accuracy 0.80 in an external unit dataset. The study is retrospective.
